title: Mark 1:21-31 — Jesus Teaches in Capernaum Synagogue
summary: Jesus teaches with authority in the synagogue, casts out a demon, and heals Simon's mother-in-law.
narration: In Capernaum, on the Sabbath day, Jesus entered a synagogue and began to teach. Those listening were astonished, for he taught with authority, unlike the scribes. At once, a man in their midst cried out, 'What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!' Jesus looked at him and said, 'Be quiet, and come out of him!' With a violent cry, the unclean spirit convulsed the man and then left him. All were amazed, whispering among themselves, 'What is this new doctrine? He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!' The news spread quickly throughout Galilee and beyond. Leaving the synagogue, Jesus went to the house of Simon and Andrew, where James and John were also present. There, Simon’s wife’s mother lay ill with a fever. They told Jesus about her, and he came to her, took her by the hand, and raised her up. Immediately, the fever left her, and she rose to serve them.
source_text: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught. They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes. Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out, saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!” Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!” The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him. They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!” The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area. Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John. Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her. He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
